basis: GitHub pull-request court record and merged programme-state evidence; descriptions freeze repository-observed coordination behaviour, not scientific/market claims.

events.evidence_statement: The repository-wide integration lane was held while required Python checks polled; PR #639 identifies unrelated cross-PR head-of-line blocking and moves observation outside the serial lane.
C2P2-WP0 had passing exact-head tests/profile work but was superseded after main advanced through PYT-G1 and the higher-priority integration lane moved.
DSAI-WP8 reconciliation was superseded after main-head movement and recreated from current lawful main.
A second DSAI-WP8 reconciliation was superseded after main advanced again, requiring PR #646.
C2P2-WP1 implementation, canonical tests, parity and profile assurance passed, but final readiness failed solely with OVC_BASE_MOVED_BEFORE_READINESS.
DSAI-WP9 exact merge readiness rejected a stale event base after main moved; the bounded work had to be refreshed.
Current main was merged into the isolated DSAI-WP9 branch solely to refresh final G9A evidence after CI infrastructure changed.
DSAI-WP9 G9A preparation was superseded when main advanced before the operator decision was materialised.
C2P2-WP1 was closed without merge because unrelated CI/DSAI work materially advanced main before final qualification.
DSAI-G9B qualification required a non-authority current-main sync after PVS2 advanced main.
DSAI-G9B qualification required another current-main sync after the PVS2 completion receipt advanced main.
DSAI-G9B qualification required another sync after the EI-WP1 authority receipt advanced main.
DSAI-G9B qualification required a fourth additive current-main synchronization before activation evidence could be finalised.
An already approved CIPR-G4 decision had to be rematerialised because unrelated main-head movement made the prior evidence branch stale.
DSAI-WP10 required current-main synchronization after separately governed CI-performance evidence advanced main during implementation.
An otherwise-green exact-head assurance cycle was discarded when main moved before readiness; this became the direct empirical trigger for the PDC final-integration-window correction.
PDC moved the shared integration lane ahead of expensive final assurance and held one exact main snapshot, preserving fail-closed head checks while serialising only final integration.
DSAI-WP11 required a bounded current-main reconciliation after merge readiness correctly failed closed on a stale event base.
The PDC corrective branch itself required current-main reconciliation before final exact-head assurance.
The PDC terminal receipt records COMPLETED / PARALLEL_BUILD_SERIALIZED_FINAL_INTEGRATION_WINDOW_ACTIVE.
A preserved C2P2-WP1 reconciliation PR became non-mergeable and the packet had to be reconstructed non-destructively from current main.
A frozen EI-WP1 binding identity discrepancy required a separately governed versioned correction before PYT-WP2 could lawfully resume.
The EI closeout explicitly records the next action as resuming PYT-WP2, demonstrating a dependency crossing programme queues.
ESLI-WP1, WP2 and WP3 formed a deterministic sequential packet train with delegated gates and automatic continuation from latest lawful main.
C2P2 progressed WP0 to WP1 and immediately to WP2 after lawful integration, exhibiting the same multi-packet train pattern.
PYT-WP2 was open from main while other programmes continued; its branch is a live independently executing development queue.
C2P2-WP2 was simultaneously open from the same main baseline as PYT-WP2, proving active parallel construction rather than hypothetical future concurrency.
At capture, C2P, PYT, RCN and ESLI work were simultaneously open at different lifecycle stages, while PDC preserved a single serialized final-integration frontier.
